title: Reading the Allowance an Account Already Stands With before a New Lot
content:
On the plans granted allowance each service day, what an Employee Meal Account already stands with is taken off the new lot, and how that standing figure is read turns on whether allowance has lately been applied.

**Clause.** Where the plan grants allowance on a daily basis and allowance has been applied on the account at least once in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, the allowance already standing is read as the unspent allowance figure the account carries. Where the plan grants allowance on a daily basis and no allowance has been applied on the account in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked, the allowance already standing is recomputed from the ledger as every lot granted in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked less every application made in that month, floored at nothing. Where neither holds, nothing is treated as already standing.

## How each plan is granted allowance

| Meal plan | Allowance granted |
|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | none |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | none |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | none |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | each service day |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | each service day |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | each calendar month |

## The three readings

| Plan's grant basis | Allowance applied in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked | The allowance already standing |
|---|---|---|
| Each service day | At least once | The unspent allowance figure the account carries |
| Each service day | Not at all | Lots granted in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked less applications made in that month, never below nothing |
| Any other basis | Either | Nothing |

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical figures)

*Input.* An account on a plan granted allowance each service day; no allowance applied in the calendar month running back from the day the account is worked; lots granted in that month totalling $95.00; applications made in that month totalling nothing; the unspent allowance figure on the account reading $12.00.

*Judgement.* A daily basis with no application in the month is recomputed from the ledger rather than read off the account.

*Output.* $95.00 less nothing, or $95.00.

Had one application been made in that month, the standing figure would have been the $12.00 the account carries.
